carbonated_table_waters.name: Sparkling Waters
carbonated_table_waters.observation: Spring water is bottled under gas and sold at table, and the stoneware bottles come back to be refilled.

food_retorts.observation: Meat and vegetables are sealed in jars and tin cases and boiled, and the ration opened a year later is still sound.
food_retorts.ability_reason: An army or a ship can now carry a year of sound food instead of salt meat and biscuit alone.

humidity_measurement.observation: Storekeepers hang hair gauges in the granary and know from the reading when grain will sweat and mould.

root_beet_sugar.name: Beet Sugar
root_beet_sugar.observation: The pale field root is sliced, soaked and boiled down in factories, and sugar no longer comes only from hot lands across the sea.
root_beet_sugar.ability_reason: Cold lands grow their own sugar, and a luxury becomes an everyday food of the poor.
root_beet_sugar.social_consequence: Sugar enters every kitchen; teeth rot earlier and the beet factory decides what the district plants.

farm_improvement_societies.name: Farm Societies
farm_improvement_societies.observation: Farmers meet at shows to judge beasts and ploughing, and the prize-winner's methods are copied across the district.

pedigree_herd_books.name: Herd Books
pedigree_herd_books.observation: Printed herd books record every sire and dam, and a pedigree bull sells for the price of a farm.
pedigree_herd_books.ability_reason: Breeders can now fix a line of heavy, milky or woolly stock and prove it to buyers.
pedigree_herd_books.social_consequence: Old local breeds are crossed out or lost; small farmers cannot afford the registered bull.

pressed_bakers_yeast.name: Pressed Yeast
pressed_bakers_yeast.observation: Distilleries press and sell fresh yeast in cakes, and town bakers raise a lighter, more even loaf.

cocoa_press_chocolate.name: Eating Chocolate
cocoa_press_chocolate.observation: Cocoa is pressed of its fat and moulded into bars that keep for months in the pocket.

household_preserving_jars.name: Preserving Jars
household_preserving_jars.observation: Cheap glass jars with screw lids let every kitchen put up fruit and beans for the winter.
household_preserving_jars.social_consequence: Autumn becomes preserving season; a badly sealed jar poisons a household now and then.

vacuum_pan_sugar.name: Vacuum Pans
vacuum_pan_sugar.observation: Sugar is boiled under a vacuum at low heat, and the crystals come out whiter and with less burnt syrup.

oilcake_winter_feed.name: Oil-cake Feed
oilcake_winter_feed.observation: Pressed cake left over from the oil mills is bought to fatten stock through the winter, and their dung enriches the fields.

sheep_scab_dipping.name: Sheep Dipping
sheep_scab_dipping.observation: Flocks are driven through troughs of arsenic and sulphur wash against scab and ticks.

mechanical_reaper.name: Mechanical Reaper
mechanical_reaper.observation: A horse-drawn machine cuts in a day what a gang of reapers cut in a week.
mechanical_reaper.ability_reason: Harvest no longer waits on hired hands, and a family farm can crop far more land.
mechanical_reaper.social_consequence: Harvest gangs lose their work; a slip at the knife bar costs a hand or a leg.

steel_scouring_plough.name: Steel Plough
steel_scouring_plough.observation: A polished steel mouldboard scours clean through sticky prairie sod that clogs an iron plough.

nutrient_response_trials.observation: Side-by-side plots receive measured nitrogen, phosphorus and potash, and the yields show which each soil lacks.
nutrient_response_trials.ability_reason: Farmers can now feed a field exactly what it lacks rather than guessing with dung and marl.

soil_infiltration_trials.observation: Water is poured into rings on the field, and the time it takes to sink tells whether to drain or mulch.

seabird_guano_trade.name: Guano Trade
seabird_guano_trade.observation: Ships bring dried seabird dung from far rock islands, and a sack of it doubles a field's yield.
seabird_guano_trade.social_consequence: Islands are stripped to bare rock, and labourers on them are held in hard bondage.

mineral_nitrate_dressing.observation: Mined nitrate from the dry coasts is spread on grain in spring, and the crop darkens and thickens.

mulch_water_management.observation: Straw mulch is laid at measured depths, and the deeper beds hold their moisture through the dry weeks.

phosphate_dressing.observation: Ground phosphate rock is dressed on thin soils and on root crops, and the turnips swell.

experimental_farm_station.name: Experiment Station
experimental_farm_station.observation: A station keeps the same plots under the same treatments year after year and publishes the yields.
experimental_farm_station.ability_reason: Agriculture now has a standing laboratory, and each decade's methods are tested against the last.
experimental_farm_station.social_consequence: A salaried station director now advises the ministry and the farm societies.

phosphate_solubilization.observation: Bones and phosphate rock are treated with vitriol in factories, and the soluble dressing acts in a single season.

machine_tile_drainage.name: Tile Drainage
machine_tile_drainage.observation: Machines extrude clay pipes by the thousand, and wet clay fields are laid with drains a yard deep.
machine_tile_drainage.social_consequence: Wet meadows and marsh margins vanish under tile drains.

famine_relief_works.name: Famine Relief
famine_relief_works.observation: In a blight famine the state buys foreign grain and puts the starving to work on roads for a ration.
famine_relief_works.social_consequence: Relief comes late and is tied to hard labour; the famine is remembered against the rulers for generations.

heated_glasshouses.name: Heated Glasshouses
heated_glasshouses.observation: Glasshouses heated by hot-water pipes force grapes, cucumbers and early greens in winter.

intensive_gardens.observation: Market gardens near the towns crop four times a year on town manure to pay their high rents.

steam_threshing_sets.name: Steam Threshing
steam_threshing_sets.observation: A steam engine and threshing drum travel from farm to farm, and a winter's flail work is done in days.
steam_threshing_sets.social_consequence: Winter threshing work, long the landless labourer's living, disappears.

food_adulteration_tests.name: Adulteration Tests
food_adulteration_tests.observation: The microscope and the chemist show chalk in bread, water in milk and leaves of hedges in tea.

graded_grain_elevators.name: Graded Elevators
graded_grain_elevators.observation: Grain is dumped by bucket belt into bins and sold by the inspector's grade, not by the sack.

chemical_baking_powder.name: Baking Powder
chemical_baking_powder.observation: A powder of soda and acid raises cakes and quick bread without waiting on yeast.

condensed_milk.name: Condensed Milk
condensed_milk.observation: Milk boiled down with sugar keeps in sealed tins, and soldiers and sailors carry it far from any cow.
condensed_milk.social_consequence: Poor mothers feed it thinned to infants, who fall behind the breast-fed.

fermentation_starter_cultures.observation: Brewers and dairies keep pure cultures of one yeast or souring germ, and batches stop going wrong.

plant_pathology_diagnosis.observation: Growers learn that blights and rusts are living fungi and name each by its marks on leaf and stem.
plant_pathology_diagnosis.ability_reason: Crop disease can be named, traced and fought instead of blamed on weather and bad air.

can_body_forming.observation: Machines cut, roll and solder tin bodies by the hundred, and canned food falls within reach of the town poor.

farm_colleges_ministry.name: Farm Colleges
farm_colleges_ministry.observation: Chartered colleges teach farming as a science, and a ministry of agriculture speaks for the land in the cabinet.
farm_colleges_ministry.ability_reason: Farming has its own ministry and its own schooled professionals.
farm_colleges_ministry.social_consequence: A farm minister now sits at the council table; the countryside has a voice and a budget.

gentle_heat_treatment.name: Gentle Heat Treatment
gentle_heat_treatment.observation: Wine, beer and milk are warmed just short of boiling for a set time, and they no longer sour or carry fevers.
gentle_heat_treatment.ability_reason: Milk can be made safe for children, and wine and beer keep through long voyages.

meat_extract_cubes.name: Meat Extract
meat_extract_cubes.observation: Beef is boiled down to a dark paste and pressed into cubes that make a broth anywhere.

beef_fat_margarine.name: Margarine
beef_fat_margarine.observation: A butter substitute is churned from beef fat and skim milk, cheap enough for the labourer's bread.

roller_grain_milling.observation: Steel rollers grind flour whiter and faster than stones, and the germ and bran are sifted away.
roller_grain_milling.ability_reason: Mills can feed great cities with flour that keeps for months.
roller_grain_milling.social_consequence: White bread becomes everyone's bread, and the poor lose the germ and bran that fed them.

twine_binding_harvester.name: Twine Binder
twine_binding_harvester.observation: The harvester cuts the grain and ties every sheaf with twine, and one man follows where five bound by hand.

food_adulteration_law.name: Adulteration Law
food_adulteration_law.observation: Public analysts test food bought on the open market, and a grocer who sells chalked flour is fined in open court.
food_adulteration_law.ability_reason: Food sold in the market is now what it claims to be, by law and by test.
food_adulteration_law.social_consequence: The public analyst is a new town officer; grocers call the law meddling.

frozen_meat_trade.name: Frozen Meat Trade
frozen_meat_trade.observation: Refrigerated holds carry frozen carcasses across the ocean from grazing lands, and meat reaches the labourer's table weekly.
frozen_meat_trade.ability_reason: Distant grasslands now feed the industrial towns with meat.
frozen_meat_trade.social_consequence: Home graziers are undersold, and the grazing lands are shaped around the export ships.

cream_separator.name: Cream Separator
cream_separator.observation: A spinning bowl throws the cream from the milk in minutes, instead of skimming pans overnight.

resistant_vine_rootstocks.name: Resistant Rootstocks
resistant_vine_rootstocks.observation: Vines are grafted onto wild roots that the root-louse cannot kill, and ruined vineyards are replanted.

cooperative_creameries.name: Cooperative Creameries
cooperative_creameries.observation: Farmers pool their milk in a creamery they own together and share the butter money by the gallon.

silage_towers.name: Silage
silage_towers.observation: Chopped green fodder is packed into towers and pits, and it keeps cattle in milk through the winter.

copper_lime_spray.name: Copper-lime Spray
copper_lime_spray.observation: Vines and potatoes are sprayed blue with copper and lime, and the mildew and blight are held off.

double_seaming.observation: Can lids are rolled onto the body in a double seam with no solder, and lead no longer taints the food.

bottled_town_milk.name: Bottled Milk
bottled_town_milk.observation: Heat-treated milk is bottled and delivered to town doors each morning, and summer infant diarrhoea falls.

butterfat_milk_test.name: Butterfat Test
butterfat_milk_test.observation: A simple acid test measures butterfat, and the dairy pays by the test instead of the gallon, ending watered milk.

dietary_heat_units.name: Diet Heat Units
dietary_heat_units.observation: Foods are burned in a closed vessel to measure their heat, and rations for soldiers and workhouses are costed by it.
dietary_heat_units.ability_reason: Diets can now be planned and costed by what they give the body, not only by weight.
dietary_heat_units.social_consequence: Workhouse and barracks rations are cut to the calculated minimum.

deficiency_disease_discovery.name: Deficiency Diseases
deficiency_disease_discovery.observation: Fowls fed on polished rice sicken and recover on the husk, and the old beriberi is shown to come from a missing part of food.

chilled_fruit_shipping.name: Chilled Fruit
chilled_fruit_shipping.observation: Bananas and oranges come in cold ships from hot lands and are sold from barrows in winter.

progeny_rows.observation: Seed from single chosen plants is sown in its own row, and the true-breeding lines are kept.

controlled_pollination.observation: Breeders bag the flowers and dust them by hand with pollen of the chosen father.

field_variety_trials.observation: Varieties are sown in replicated plots across the field, and the yields are compared with the reckoning of chance.

heredity_experiments.observation: Crossing experiments show traits passing in fixed ratios, and breeders can plan a variety instead of hoping for one.
heredity_experiments.ability_reason: Plant and animal breeding becomes a planned craft with predictable results.

regional_seed_trials.observation: Trial farms in each district name the varieties that do best in that soil and weather.

school_meals.name: School Meals
school_meals.observation: Poor children are given a hot midday meal at school, and they grow and learn better for it.
school_meals.social_consequence: The school takes on a parent's duty; some call it charity that shames the household.

plant_resistance_trait_trials.observation: Wheat and flax are bred from parents that stand up to rust and wilt, and the resistance is fixed in the line.

food_acidity_measurement.observation: Preserved foods are tested for acidity, and low-acid foods get longer heating so they cannot breed the canning poison.

clean_milk_ordinances.name: Clean Milk Law
clean_milk_ordinances.observation: Dairies are licensed, herds tested for the wasting cough, and milk from diseased cows is poured away.
clean_milk_ordinances.social_consequence: Small cow-keepers in town yards are put out of business by the inspector.

vitamin_factors.name: Vitamins
vitamin_factors.observation: Feeding trials show that tiny amounts of accessory factors in fresh food prevent scurvy, rickets and beriberi.
vitamin_factors.ability_reason: Diet can now be judged by what it contains, not only by how much fills the belly.

farm_extension_agents.name: Extension Agents
farm_extension_agents.observation: A salaried adviser drives from farm to farm with the station's results and demonstration plots.

ammonium_sulfate_fertilizer.observation: Nitrogen fixed from the air in factories is sold as ammonium salt, and no field need go hungry for nitrogen again.
ammonium_sulfate_fertilizer.ability_reason: Fertility no longer depends on dung, guano or mined nitrate; the fields can feed a far larger people.
ammonium_sulfate_fertilizer.social_consequence: Runoff greens the rivers and ponds; the same plants make explosives in wartime.

farm_tractor.name: Farm Tractor
farm_tractor.observation: A light petrol tractor pulls the plough and binder, and the land kept for horse feed goes to food.
farm_tractor.ability_reason: One family can farm far more land, and horse pasture is freed for crops.
farm_tractor.social_consequence: Farm hands and horsemen leave for the towns; overturned tractors kill farmers.

wartime_ration_cards.name: Ration Cards
wartime_ration_cards.observation: In total war a food ministry issues ration cards, fixes prices and sets every household's share of meat, fat and sugar.
wartime_ration_cards.ability_reason: The whole people can be fed fairly through blockade and war.
wartime_ration_cards.social_consequence: A food ministry and ration offices stand in every town; black markets and informers follow.

forced_air_grain_drying.observation: Fans blow heated air through the grain bins, and a wet harvest no longer rots in store.

grain_moisture_testing.observation: Grain is tested for moisture before it goes into the bin, and damp lots are dried first.

thermal_process_validation.observation: Heating times are proven for each can size by thermometers in the coldest spot, and canning poison nearly vanishes.

rickets_prevention.name: Rickets Cure
rickets_prevention.observation: Children bent by rickets straighten on fish-liver oil and sunlight, and fewer girls grow up with narrowed pelvises.

iodized_salt.name: Iodized Salt
iodized_salt.observation: A trace of iodide added to table salt ends goitre and cretinism in the mountain valleys.

hybrid_maize_seed.name: Hybrid Maize
hybrid_maize_seed.observation: Seed from crossed inbred lines yields a third more, but farmers must buy new seed every year.
hybrid_maize_seed.ability_reason: Grain yields rise sharply in maize country.
hybrid_maize_seed.social_consequence: Farmers depend on the seed company each spring; the old saved seed is abandoned.

quick_frozen_foods.name: Quick-frozen Foods
quick_frozen_foods.observation: Food is frozen fast between cold plates and sold in packets that taste nearly fresh.

contour_cultivation.observation: Furrows are ploughed along the slope instead of down it, and rain stays on the field.

cover_crop_mixtures.observation: Rye and vetch are sown after harvest to hold the soil through the winter rains.

strip_cropping.observation: Strips of grain and grass alternate across the field, breaking the wind and the running water.

household_refrigerator.name: Household Refrigerator
household_refrigerator.observation: An electric cold box in the kitchen keeps milk, meat and greens for a week.

soil_conservation_service.name: Soil Conservation
soil_conservation_service.observation: After the dust storms a state service lays out terraces and shelter belts and pays farmers to rest eroded land.
soil_conservation_service.social_consequence: A soil service and district boards now tell farmers how to plough.

hitch_tractor.name: Hitch Tractor
hitch_tractor.observation: Rubber tyres, a power shaft and a three-point hitch let the tractor lift and drive every implement.

combine_harvester.name: Combine Harvester
combine_harvester.observation: One machine cuts, threshes and cleans the grain as it drives, and the harvest crew shrinks to two.

recommended_daily_allowances.name: Daily Allowances
recommended_daily_allowances.observation: A board sets how much of each nutrient a person needs each day, and white flour is enriched with iron and vitamins.

food_group_guides.name: Food Guides
food_group_guides.observation: Posters in schools and clinics show the food groups every household should eat each day.

synthetic_crop_insecticide.name: Synthetic Insecticide
synthetic_crop_insecticide.observation: A synthetic contact poison dusted on crops kills beetles and caterpillars for weeks.
synthetic_crop_insecticide.social_consequence: Birds and fish die along the sprayed fields, and the poison builds up in bodies.

selective_hormone_herbicide.name: Hormone Weedkiller
selective_hormone_herbicide.observation: A spray that kills broad-leaved weeds but spares the grain replaces weeks of hoeing.

artificial_cattle_insemination.name: Artificial Insemination
artificial_cattle_insemination.observation: Frozen semen of proven bulls is carried to every farm, and one sire fathers thousands of calves.

confinement_broiler_houses.name: Broiler Houses
confinement_broiler_houses.observation: Chickens are raised by the thousand under lights on mill feed, and chicken becomes cheap weekday meat.
confinement_broiler_houses.social_consequence: Crowded flocks breed new fevers, and the sheds' waste fouls the streams.

food_batch_traceability.observation: Every batch carries a code from farm to shop, and a tainted lot is recalled within days.

postharvest_loss_measurement.observation: Losses between the field and the table are measured at each step and cut where they are worst.

soil_moisture_scheduling.observation: Irrigation is given when soil gauges show the root zone drying, not by habit.

self_service_cold_stores.name: Self-service Stores
self_service_cold_stores.observation: Shoppers take goods from open shelves and cold cabinets and pay at the door.

centre_pivot_irrigation.name: Centre-pivot Irrigation
centre_pivot_irrigation.observation: A pipe on wheels turns slowly round a well, watering a great green circle in dry country.
centre_pivot_irrigation.social_consequence: Groundwater falls year by year under the circles.

food_process_hazard_analysis.observation: Each step of food processing is examined for what could go wrong, and a check is set at every critical point.
food_process_hazard_analysis.ability_reason: Food poisoning from factory foods becomes rare.

food_package_barrier_testing.observation: Wrapping films are tested for how much air and water pass through them.

food_water_activity_measurement.observation: The free water in food is measured to set its shelf life safely.

food_package_leak_detection.observation: Sealed packages are tested for leaks before they leave the plant.

inter_realm_food_standards.name: Food Standards Code
inter_realm_food_standards.observation: Realms agree one code of food standards, and food can cross borders without a new test at every port.

drip_irrigation.name: Drip Irrigation
drip_irrigation.observation: Thin lines drip water to each plant's roots, and a dry farm uses half the water.

reduced_tillage.observation: The last crop's stubble is left on the field and the seed drilled through it, and the soil stops blowing.

semi_dwarf_grain_package.name: Semi-dwarf Grain
semi_dwarf_grain_package.observation: Short-strawed wheat and rice that do not fall over under heavy fertilizer double the harvest where there is water.
semi_dwarf_grain_package.ability_reason: Famine recedes from the crowded rice and wheat lands.
semi_dwarf_grain_package.social_consequence: Farmers need fertilizer, water and bought seed; old varieties vanish and the aquifers fall.

food_banks.name: Food Banks
food_banks.observation: Volunteers gather surplus food from shops and farms and give it to families who run short.

microwave_oven.name: Microwave Oven
microwave_oven.observation: A box of invisible waves heats a meal in minutes.

aseptic_carton_milk.name: Carton Milk
aseptic_carton_milk.observation: Sterile milk sealed in layered cartons keeps for months without a cold room.

integrated_pest_management.name: Integrated Pest Management
integrated_pest_management.observation: Scouts count pests in the field and spray only when a threshold is crossed.

starch_sugar_syrup.name: Starch Syrup
starch_sugar_syrup.observation: Maize starch is turned by enzymes into a cheap syrup that sweetens drinks and bread.
starch_sugar_syrup.social_consequence: Cheap sweetness fills the diet; the poor grow fat and fall sick with the sugar sickness.

net_pen_aquaculture.name: Net-pen Fish Farms
net_pen_aquaculture.observation: Salmon and bream are fattened in floating net pens on pellets of fish meal.
net_pen_aquaculture.social_consequence: Lice and waste from the pens spread to the wild fish.

national_dietary_goals.name: Dietary Goals
national_dietary_goals.observation: The state sets goals against too much fat, salt and sugar in the national diet.

hydroponic_glasshouses.name: Hydroponic Glasshouses
hydroponic_glasshouses.observation: Tomatoes and peppers grow in channels of fed water under glass, without soil.

famine_early_warning.name: Famine Early Warning
famine_early_warning.observation: Rainfall, market prices and images from above warn of a coming famine months ahead.

nutrition_labels.name: Nutrition Labels
nutrition_labels.observation: Every packet carries a label of its energy, fat, salt and sugar.

therapeutic_ready_food.name: Therapeutic Paste
therapeutic_ready_food.observation: A paste of peanut, milk and vitamins lets starving children be treated at home instead of in a feeding ward.

transgenic_crops.name: Transgenic Crops
transgenic_crops.observation: Crops carrying a gene moved from another creature resist pests or survive the weedkiller.
transgenic_crops.ability_reason: Farmers spray less insecticide and lose less of the crop.
transgenic_crops.social_consequence: The seed is patented, and a great quarrel divides the people over what may be eaten.

folic_acid_fortification.name: Folic Acid Flour
folic_acid_fortification.observation: A vitamin added to flour prevents many children being born with open spines.

precision_agriculture.name: Precision Agriculture
precision_agriculture.observation: Tractors steered by signals from the sky vary seed and fertilizer yard by yard.

marker_assisted_breeding.name: Marker-assisted Breeding
marker_assisted_breeding.observation: Breeders read hereditary markers in a seedling's leaf and keep only the plants that carry the wanted trait.

biofortified_staples.name: Biofortified Staples
biofortified_staples.observation: Orange sweet potato, iron beans and zinc wheat bring vitamins into the poorest diets.

stress_tolerant_varieties.name: Stress-tolerant Varieties
stress_tolerant_varieties.observation: Rice that survives weeks under flood water and maize that sets seed in drought are bred for the poorest farms.

sugar_drink_taxes.name: Sugar Drink Tax
sugar_drink_taxes.observation: A tax on sugared drinks cuts how much children drink of them.

gene_edited_crops.name: Gene-edited Crops
gene_edited_crops.observation: A crop's own genes are edited at one point, without carrying in a gene from another creature.
gene_edited_crops.ability_reason: Varieties can be changed in a few seasons rather than a breeder's lifetime.

precision_fermented_proteins.name: Precision Fermentation
precision_fermented_proteins.observation: Microbes in steel tanks make milk and egg proteins without cows or hens.

cultivated_cell_meat.name: Cultivated Meat
cultivated_cell_meat.observation: Meat is grown from animal cells in tanks, though it is still dear and rare.

nitrogen_fixing_seed_microbes.name: Nitrogen-fixing Seed Coats
nitrogen_fixing_seed_microbes.observation: Seed coated with nitrogen-fixing microbes needs less bought fertilizer.

vertical_indoor_farms.name: Vertical Farms
vertical_indoor_farms.observation: Greens grow in stacked trays under electric light in city warehouses.

climate_shift_crop_planning.name: Climate Crop Planning
climate_shift_crop_planning.observation: District crop maps are redrawn as the climate shifts, moving varieties and sowing dates to follow the rain.
climate_shift_crop_planning.ability_reason: Farming adapts to a warming climate before the failed harvests force it.
